title: Staged traffic guardrail with multi-metric abort and counterfactual tracing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a staged traffic guardrail that monitors A/B and staged deployments using multiple quality signals and a counterfactual tracing path. Objective: detect regressions quickly and target aborts to affected cohorts while minimizing false positives. This ticket covers the orchestration logic, metric math, trace correlation, and operator tooling to declare, investigate, and confirm automated aborts. Key behaviors: 1) continuous scoring of cohorts against baseline using both task-level metrics (accuracy, F1 for labelled evals) and production proxies (latency p95, hallucination heuristic, user drop-rate), 2) counterfactual traces that replay a sample of affected requests against the previous stable model/config to provide an explainable diff, 3) graduated abort thresholds (soft alert -> partial divert -> hard abort) tied to traffic fraction and confidence, 4) integration with rollout controller to perform automated partial or full reversion and to emit audit events for postmortem. Note: aim for low CPU/GPU overhead by applying sampling + lightweight replay hooks; avoid duplicating heavy model inference for all traffic by leveraging prefix/KV cache warm paths and stored prompt snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can subscribe to per-cohort metrics and make abort decisions based on a multi-metric policy file
Counterfactual traces produced for at least 1% of affected traffic and viewable in Console with side-by-side outputs
Automated aborts can perform partial traffic re-routes (down to cohort level) and full rollback to a pinned model version
Operators can configure soft vs hard thresholds and an adjudication window (minutes) via Console rollout UI
System emits structured audit events (route, decision, metrics snapshot, trace ids) to the audit log and to the incident dashboard
tasks: Design policy DSL for multi-metric aborts (proto + validation) - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-runtime/pull/2151
Implement controller hook for staggered divert + abort flow in rollout service
Add counterfactual trace sampler and lightweight replay executor (uses stored request proto)
Console: add guardrail panel showing live cohort scores and trace viewer link
End-to-end QA: synthetic regression injection, verify partial re-route and rollback behavior
Docs: playbook for operators describing how to tune thresholds and interpret traces
notes: Trade-offs considered: full deterministic replay vs sampled counterfactuals. Chose sampled to keep cost linear to traffic sample, with ability to increase sample during investigation.
Performance: keep replay lightweight by reusing cached tokens and using smaller model variants for counterfactuals when possible (configurable in policy).
Safety: soft alerts should never automatically change user-visible model until grace/adjudication window passes; hard abort reserved for high-confidence, high-severity regressions.
Data retention: traces stored for 30 days by default; admins can extend. Must surface KMS key used for trace encryption in Console.
Related: aligns with Dedicated autoscale fallback patterns (ENG-89211) and eval gating infra (ENG-90234).

Latency regressions correlated with long tail KV cache misses; add cache-miss rate as a gating metric
